reason: The collection preserves genuine lab observations, but its completed records predate the enforced frozen-executable, process-owned forwarding, stable schema-v3 input and fully bound reset-operation chain.

failedRecords.reason: The legacy fail-safe reset could continue after an earlier reset command failed.

limitations: Schema-version-1 records did not preserve the Application response and classified scan input as one atomic bundle.
The schema-version-2 metadata record preserved the classified bundle but did not bind the executed scanner and policy hashes.
The fixed forwarding process was not proven to own the listener used for collection.
Reset summaries were not bound to the frozen source revision and unique Argo CD reset initiator under the current schema-v3 rules.
